content.title: About
content.content: Instant coffee, pre‑sweetened with sugar, is a dry powder made from extracts of roasted coffee beans with added sugar. When hot water is added, it quickly turns into a fragrant, sweet‑tasting beverage.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Instant coffee was first produced commercially in the early 20th century.
The sweetened version is popular in offices and schools where adding separate sugar is inconvenient.
Most of the sugar used is regular cane sugar, though some brands use dextrose for faster dissolution.
The powder can be stored for a long time without flavor loss if kept dry and sealed.
In some countries, sweetened instant coffee is classified as a separate product category.

items.title: Quick energy
items.content: Sugar provides an immediate source of glucose, helping to restore energy rapidly.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee contains polyphenols that act as antioxidants and may protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Improved focus
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, enhancing alertness and concentration.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Caffeine can boost metabolic rate, aiding calorie burning.

items.title: Convenient preparation
items.content: Instant coffee is ready in seconds, making it ideal for time‑pressed situations.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: High sugar levels can contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of diabetes when consumed frequently.

items.title: Caffeine
items.content: Excessive caffeine intake may cause anxiety, insomnia, and rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Coffee allergy
items.content: A small number of people may experience allergic reactions to coffee components.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Coffee’s acidity can irritate the stomach in individuals with gastritis or ulcers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix 1‑2 teaspoons of the powder with 200‑250 ml of hot (not boiling) water and stir until fully dissolved. Optionally add milk or cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the package in a dry, cool place away from moisture and direct sunlight. After opening, seal tightly to prevent moisture absorption.
